by_video_id_and_guru_id.note: many spans legitimately share one (video, teacher) pair; this level is reported as a count only because it is not an identity defect

notes: Tier 1 is an automated-evidence candidate, not a public-verified corpus: human speaker-label certification (B7) and owner rights sign-off (B5) are open.
Variant and unlocatable spans are never served by default.
The speaker-conflict quarantine is a separate artifact so a human can review it row by row.
No row is deduplicated and no row is dropped: the tier counts reconcile exactly with the Phase-3 input rows.

A deterministic id collision quarantines EVERY member. The rebuilt id namespace is not changed (that would re-key the corpus and invalidate the Phase-2 verdicts), so the collision is recorded as unresolved.

tier_descriptions.deterministic_id_collision_quarantine: Distinct source spans that produced the same deterministic rebuilt id. Every member is quarantined; none is kept and none is dropped. Never served.
tier_descriptions.local_review_candidate: Exact Phase-3 reconstruction + Phase-2 per-span verdict 'verified' + confirmed rights. Servable ONLY by the owner-only local test mode. Not public-verified: attribution is automated evidence, not human-certified.
tier_descriptions.review_required: Human-review records: speaker-label conflicts, rights-pending spans and spans whose acoustic evidence did not pass. Never served.
tier_descriptions.unlocatable_quarantine: Spans not located in the authoritative word-timed artifact. The live span identity is recovered where the Phase-3 manifest carries it, together with a deterministic quarantine record id. No audio window, no evidence. Never served.
tier_descriptions.variant_candidate: Transcript/text variants — one row per source span. Never served by default; a separate explicit owner decision is required.
